name: image-resizer
description: Tiny client-side tool that resizes oversized images and copies them to your clipboard — to stop losing AI chat sessions to the "image too large" error.

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p public/vendor && cp node_modules/heic-to/dist/iife/heic-to.js public/vendor/heic-to.js && cp node_modules/jszip/dist/jszip.min.js public/vendor/jszip.min.js && cp node_modules/pdf-lib/dist/pdf-lib.min.js public/vendor/pdf-lib.min.js && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs public/vendor/pdf.min.mjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs public/vendor/pdf.worker.min.mjs
